label: Bone-spicule pigmentary retinopathy
article_title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Pantothenate Kinase-Associated Neurodegeneration (PKAN): A Systematic Review.
quote: Classic PKAN is characterized by progressive stiffness, pigmentary retinal degeneration, dysarthria, dystonia, and choreoathetosis beginning in infancy (before six years of age in 88% of cases).
